descriptionChirho: To come upon or meet someone, often unexpectedly or by chance (Qal).
To extend to or reach a geographical boundary or limit (Qal).
To strike or fall upon someone violently, to smite or assault (Qal).
To make intercession, entreat, or plead with someone on behalf of another (Qal and Hifil).

labelChirho: lay upon, cause to fall on
descriptionChirho: To cause something to light upon or be laid on someone, including striking a target (Hifil causative).
